claims.claim_ar: جذر «حرم» بمعنى: النهْى/جعل الشيء حرامًا؛ هنا الفعل في آية التحريم (حُرِّمَتْ) يحمل معنى الحظر/التكفير.
claims.claim_en: Root 'حرم' means 'to forbid, to make (something) forbidden/untouchable'. In the verse it appears in the passive ('حُرِّمَتْ') expressing that something has been made forbidden.

claims.claim_ar: وزن الفعل لمعنى التحريم: فَعَّلَ (حَرَّمَ)؛ صيغة الماضي المبني للمجهول من فَعَّلَ هي فُعِّلَ (حُرِّمَتْ).
claims.claim_en: Lemma 'حarram' is form II (pattern fāʻʻala / فَعَّلَ). The past passive of this pattern is fُa''ila (فُعِّلَ) — here realized as 'حُرِّمَتْ' in the verse.

claims.claim_ar: جذر «جمع» بمعنى: التَّجْمِيع/الالتقاء (جمع الشيء أو الناس). الفعل الثلاثي المجرد: فَعَلَ (جَمَعَ).
claims.claim_en: Root 'جمع' means 'to gather, collect, bring together'. The basic lemma is Form I (fa'ala) 'جَمَعَ'.

warnings: source_quote_ar 'تحريمها' is a noun/masdar form found in the commentary chunk, not the exact inflected verb form 'حُرِّمَتْ' as in the ayah; used here to support root and pattern claims.
source_quote_ar 'اجْمَعُوا' (imperative) appears in the provided commentary chunk; the ayah word is 'تَجْمَعُوا' (imperfect). The quoted form differs in prefix/ mood but shares the same root/lemma.
